subject: Request to preserve evaluation window while PO completes
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medivex.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medivex.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — PO delay, can you keep our eval live?

Hi Laura,

Quick note — our procurement team hit an audit flag and the PO for MDX-412 has been pushed back. Finance tells me the earliest we can get a signed PO to you is Thursday 6/20. We’re mid-integration and the team is blocked by token expiry on our sandbox (we’re seeing interrupted model calls).

Is there any way Redwood can suspend the trial countdown or issue a short-term credit so our engineers can continue testing until the PO clears? We’d appreciate something modest — enough to keep the integration alive for 5 business days.

I can share the PO draft once legal signs off (should be by 6/19). Happy to confirm any terms you need.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Product Engineering, Medivex
jordan.ellis@medivex.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medivex.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — PO delay, can you keep our eval live?

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up and for the ETA. We can help keep your integration running while procurement finishes. Two pragmatic options: 

- Option A: Issue a one-time 5,000-token credit (non-recurring) valid for 7 days from issuance.
- Option B: Freeze the trial countdown for 7 calendar days while we wait for the PO.

Both options require a short mutual action note tying the credit/freeze to the incoming PO (deal MDX-412) and a commitment to complete PO by 6/20. If the PO extends past that date we’ll revisit.

If you prefer Option A, I’ll loop in finance for a quick approval and attach a temporary voucher. If Option B works, we’ll set the timer freeze immediately. Which do you prefer?

Attachment: temporary_trial_voucher.pdf (voucher stub — will be finalized after internal approval)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0122

Thanks Laura — Option A (5,000-token credit) sounds best for our engineers. That should be enough to continue testing until the PO clears.

PO status: legal signoff expected 6/19, finance routes 6/20. I’ll send the draft PO as soon as legal finishes. Please let me know any info you need on our side (billing contact, PO header, etc.).

Appreciate the quick help,
Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: MDX-412 temporary credit request — approval needed

Karthik / Marissa — looping you both in for a fast approval. Customer (Medivex, MDX-412) is mid-integration; procurement delayed the PO until ~6/20. They asked for a one-time 5,000-token credit to tide them over (non-recurring, expires 7 days from issuance).

Quick context: potential ARR $180k, onboarding ramp looks healthy, engineering dependency on sandbox continuity. I attached the voucher stub and a short internal memo.

Proposed guardrails:
- Credit: 5,000 tokens, single-use, tied to deal MDX-412
- Expiry: 7 days from issuance (non-extendable without a new approval)
- Condition: voucher null unless PO is received and recorded in HubSpot by 2028-06-21

Can you confirm approval (or suggest a different cap)? If approved I’ll issue the voucher and notify the customer.

Thanks,
Laura

Attachment: internal_approval_memo.txt
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MDX-412 temporary credit request — approval needed

Laura — approved. 5,000-token one-time credit is fine under these conditions. Add the following enforcement items before issuance: 
1) Voucher must be associated with hubspot deal ID MDX-412 and visible in billing.
2) Expiry set to 2028-06-23 23:59 PT.
3) Finance to be notified (finops@redwoodinference.com) so they can reconcile when the PO lands.

Please proceed and confirm once issued.

Karthik
VP, Sales Ops
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@medivex.com>
Cc: procurement@medivex.com
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — PO delay, can you keep our eval live? (Confirmed)

Jordan — confirmed. We’ve issued a one-time 5,000-token voucher tied to MDX-412. Terms in brief: non-recurring, expires 2028-06-23 23:59 PT, voucher void if PO is not recorded against MDX-412 by 2028-06-21. Finance has been notified.

Attachment: temporary_trial_voucher.pdf (finalized)

Please reply and confirm receipt of the voucher. Good luck with the last mile of procurement — ping me if anything slips.

Best,
Laura
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
